title: Toolshop checkout: sign-in step, billing address validation and placing an order with Bank Transfer (P1 cases from docs/test-cases.md with no known defect; TC-CPAY-7 excluded: the product renders no credit card form)

scenarios.title: Guest proceeding from cart sees the login step

steps.action: As a guest, open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart, then open the cart (checkout, step 1)
Click Proceed to checkout
expected: The sign-in step shows the customer login form

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Checkout Sign In

scenarios.title: Login step shows email, password and submit

steps.action: As a guest, open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart, then open the cart (checkout, step 1)
Click Proceed to checkout
expected: The login step shows an email field
The login step shows a password field
The login step shows a submit button

scenarios.title: Valid credentials authenticate and allow proceeding

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart, then open the cart (checkout, step 1)
Click Proceed to checkout
Log in on the sign-in step with the customer's email and password
expected: The user can proceed to the next checkout step

steps.action: Click Proceed to checkout
expected: The billing address step is shown

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Checkout Sign In

scenarios.title: Empty required field is flagged and Proceed is disabled

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart, then open the cart (checkout, step 1)
Click Proceed to checkout
On the sign-in step, log in with the customer's email and password
Click Proceed to checkout on the sign-in step
On the billing address step, clear the Address field
expected: The error "Address is required." is shown

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Checkout Billing Address

scenarios.title: Valid payment places the order and shows the invoice number

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart, then open the cart (checkout, step 1)
Click Proceed to checkout
On the sign-in step, log in with the customer's email and password
Click Proceed to checkout on the sign-in step
On the billing address step, enter a valid address (street, city, state, country and postcode) and click Proceed to checkout
On the payment step, choose Bank Transfer, enter an account name and account number, then confirm the payment twice (payment, then order)
expected: The order is placed and its invoice number is shown

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: Checkout Payment

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)

Click Proceed to checkout
On the sign-in step, log in with the customer's email and password
Click Proceed to checkout on the sign-in step

expected: The cart is empty after the order
